people.name: Habazziniah
people.line: Grandfather of Jaazaniah, a Rechabite leader.

people.name: Jaazaniah
people.line: Son of Jeremiah; a Rechabite during Jeremiah's time.

people.name: Rechab
people.line: Ancestor of the Rechabites, who were faithful to God

translations.web: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, with his brothers, all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
translations.bsb: So I took Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons—the entire house of the Rechabites—
translations.kjv: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
translations.asv: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
